reply: changes with t. The best dense polynomial basis (powers of t and A up to 3 and 4 terms) reached only about 1e-5. Adding terms like A²·e^(-t) or A²·√t improved that slightly, to about 4e-6, but nothing reached the 1e-12 target. The t-dependence is probably non-polynomial in a way I did not identify.
